components.name: Tactile Invitation
components.description: The warm personal call to action used for conversation and contact submission.
components.css: .ds-invitation { display: flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 1rem 1.1rem 0.85rem; color: var(--ink, #0c0d0d); border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--heritage-amber, #ffc078); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #0c0d0d); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), box-shadow 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-invitation:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink, #0c0d0d); } .ds-invitation:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #244bd8); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-invitation:active { transform: translate(0); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink, #0c0d0d); }

components.name: Editorial Text Field
components.description: An oversized transparent contact field defined by one structural underline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 1rem; color: var(--muted, #5f5f5f); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { display: flex; gap: 2rem; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-label b { color: var(--signal, #244bd8); font-weight: inherit; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0.6rem 0 1.2rem; color: var(--ink, #0c0d0d); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0d0d); border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 3.5rem); letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.1; transition: border-color 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #686260; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:hover, .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--signal, #244bd8); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #244bd8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--error, #bb271a); }

components.name: Warm Metadata Tag
components.description: A square cream label for technologies and operating modes.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem 0.35rem; color: var(--ink, #0c0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #b0b0ad); border-radius: 0; background: var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), border-color 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-tag:hover { color: var(--signal, #244bd8); border-color: var(--signal, #244bd8); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #244bd8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-rail { position: relative; width: 6.5rem; min-height: 32rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.1rem; color: var(--ink, #0c0d0d); border-right: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0d0d); background: var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-monogram { min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: inherit; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 850; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-name { margin-top: 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font-human, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); font-size: 0.8rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.4rem 0.28rem; color: inherit; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-human, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 610; display: flex; align-items: center; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0d0d); } .ds-name { display: none; } .ds-rail nav { position: fixed; right: 0.75rem; bottom: 0.8rem; left: 0.75rem; margin: 0; flex-direction: row; justify-content: center; gap: 0.15rem; padding: 0.48rem; background: var(--heritage-amber, #ffc078); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink, #0c0d0d); } .ds-rail nav a:hover, .ds-rail nav .ds-current { background: var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); box-shadow: none; } }

components.name: Grayscale Portrait Seal
components.description: A circular human identity marker with cream framing and a warm physical offset.
components.css: .ds-portrait { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 4.75rem 1fr; gap: 1.25rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink, #0c0d0d); background: var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--heritage-amber, #ffc078); font-family: var(--font-human, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); } .ds-portrait > div { width: 4.75rem; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); border: 3px solid var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); border-radius: 50%; outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #0c0d0d); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #686868, #171717); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--heritage-amber, #ffc078); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.06); } .ds-portrait figcaption { display: grid; gap: 0.2rem; } .ds-portrait strong { font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-portrait span { color: var(--muted, #5f5f5f); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-portrait:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #244bd8); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Contact Heritage Panel

Direct channel

components.name: Editorial Evidence Row
components.description: A cardless evidence structure that warms on hover without lifting from the proof sheet.
components.html:
02 / Reliability

Make failure visible before it becomes expensive.

Operational feedback, observability, and deliberate recovery paths.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(8rem, 0.45fr) minmax(16rem, 1.2fr) minmax(14rem, 0.8fr); gap: 2rem; padding: 3rem 0; color: var(--ink, #0c0d0d); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #b0b0ad); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Anybody', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 320ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-evidence:hover { background: var(--heritage-cream, #fff4e6); } .ds-evidence > p:first-child { color: var(--signal, #244bd8); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-evidence h3 { max-width: 13ch; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-human, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 4rem); font-weight: 670; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 0.98; } .ds-evidence > p:last-child { max-width: 36ch; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-evidence:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #244bd8); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-evidence { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a precise editorial artifact from an engineering studio: warm proofing stock, dense type, registration marks, axis labels, and hairline rules. Its systems layer makes Daniel's reasoning legible; its restored heritage layer makes the work feel personal and authored. Anybody is the engineering instrument; Newsreader is a limited human countervoice.
keyCharacteristics: Paper Blush and Registration Ink form the persistent systems canvas.
Signal Ultramarine marks system state; Heritage Amber marks person, invitation, and connection.
Anybody carries engineering structure; Newsreader supplies human and editorial emphasis.
Portrait, texture, cream inserts, and tactile offsets are deliberate identity moments.
Small screens become direct reading stacks with an amber bottom dock.

rules.name: The Backend Face Exception Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono is confined to the homepage Backend headline and process annotations. Frontend, QA, and Reliability retain Anybody with distinct role-specific treatments; Newsreader keeps its established editorial role.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine encodes systems and state. Amber encodes person, invitation, and connection.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Anybody explains the system; Newsreader reveals the person.

rules.name: The Editorial Grid Rule
rules.body: Asymmetry must stay aligned to shared rules and columns.

rules.name: The Tactile Exception Rule
rules.body: Never apply offset shadows to ordinary content rows or ambient surfaces.

dos: Do use Ultramarine for system state and technical focus.
Do use Amber and Cream for person, invitation, connection, and tactile contact.
Do reserve Newsreader for the human and editorial countervoice.
Do keep texture selective and preserve accessible contrast.
donts: Don't turn the portfolio back into a centered portrait hero or generic skill-card grid.
Don't add rounded containers, pills, gradients, glass effects, or ambient soft shadows.
Don't apply texture globally or offset shadows to ordinary content surfaces.
Don't swap the semantic jobs of blue and amber.
